comparison.objective: Translate an extraction-hood mounting foot about 7 cm while holding the hood mouth over a work mark.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization plus spring-loaded telescoping translation; no impact fracture or fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Foot reaches the green line while mouth pose remains fixed; pose-based partial credit and zero gate. Detailed tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests constrained relative translation of an assembly, not coaxial mandrel placement, controlled hammer impact, insert retention, or recovery of fractured tangs.
